en.t: “Tooth hardening” means strengthening and securing one’s lifespan.

units.source_text: 正月初一至初三，共食镜饼、猪肉、鹿肉、咸鲇鱼、萝卜等物，谓之祝齿固。

en.t: From the first to the third day of the first month, people ate kagami mochi, boar meat, venison, salted sweetfish, daikon radish, and other foods together; this was called celebrating tooth hardening.

units.source_text: 镜饼是扁圆形饼，大小二个重叠。

en.t: Kagami mochi are flat, round rice cakes, with one large and one small cake stacked together.
